blocks.text: MINNEAPOLIS — Terrence Shannon Jr. scored 12 of his career-high 34 points in the second quarter as the Minnesota Timberwolves recovered from a slow start to beat the Portland Trail Blazers 106-98 on Monday night in the opener of a two-game set. Rudy Gobert added 18 points and 15 rebounds for Minnesota, which was coming off a home loss to Chicago on Saturday night. Jaden McDaniels had 13 points for the Timberwolves, who got just six points on 2-of-13 shooting from LaMelo Ball after he went 7 for 25 against the Bulls.
